milestones.title: Foundations
milestones.outcome: The ArcForges repository builds and tests in hosted CI; the flagship contracts and the two DesktopPlatform adaptations are published; implementation repositories point at the new design.

milestones.title: First managed run on Windows
milestones.outcome: A user runs `arcforges run -- <command>` on Windows: submitted once, persisted, executed in a job object, output and exit code returned, and it survives a node restart.

milestones.title: Linux execution
milestones.outcome: The same works on native Linux through transient systemd units, with durable exit records and survival across node restarts.

milestones.title: Resource control
milestones.outcome: Many tasks run in parallel under computed budgets with pools, priorities, a parallelism policy and pressure handling; origins, permissions and approvals apply.

milestones.title: Central access and Go center
milestones.outcome: Nodes sign in to a configured center (official or self-hosted) and keep an outbound connection; clients and AI reach an explicitly selected node through the center's business API and MCP; the center runs in Go on PostgreSQL with the C# center retired (ArcForges-Design AD-0021).

milestones.title: Records and diagnosis
milestones.outcome: Users see where time went, findings with evidence and remedies, and learned estimates feed admission.

milestones.title: Toolchains and caches
milestones.outcome: .NET, Rust, C/C++ (including FASTBuild), Node and Python work uses shared managed caches, with tool concurrency tied to grants.

milestones.title: Storage and workspaces
milestones.outcome: Disk usage is analyzed and reclaimed safely, and agents get managed worktrees.

milestones.title: AI integration
milestones.outcome: Claude Code and Codex run work through ArcForges (MCP, hooks, routing) with honest coverage. Since AD-0021 the MCP route goes through the center (AF-CTR-07, AF-CTR-08).

milestones.title: Desktop
milestones.outcome: The Desktop app shows and controls all local features.

milestones.title: LAN
milestones.outcome: Superseded 2026-10-28 by ArcForges-Design AD-0021: LAN distribution is out of current delivery (roadmap RM-19); the tasks stay as history. Earlier outcome: paired machines on a LAN share work and compiler caches, free, without an account or a cloud connection.

milestones.title: Distribution
milestones.outcome: Users download, install, update and roll back signed artifacts from arcforges.com; the node, CLI and clients are installable.

milestones.title: Cloud platform, account and entitlements
milestones.outcome: The center's platform services and account lifecycle exist on the Go center (AD-0021); phones pair by QR, center features are gated by entitlement, and support bundles reach cases.

milestones.title: Remote views and notifications
milestones.outcome: Users watch their nodes live from the web and receive push notifications.

milestones.title: Commerce and Android
milestones.outcome: Users subscribe on the web (Paddle) or in Google Play, and use the Android app.

milestones.title: Operations and release candidate
milestones.outcome: Operators run the service within budgets, every journey passes in closed loop, and the acceptance register is ready for the user.
